title: Lemon-Roasted Chicken
description: This lemon-roasted chicken is quick and easy to prep and perfect for a weeknight sheet pan dinner or for serving to company. It's simple yet delicious.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C).

Combine chicken, onion, lemon slices, garlic, and rosemary together in a large bowl. Drizzle olive oil and sprinkle salt and black pepper over the chicken mixture; toss to coat. Spread chicken mixture out in the bottom of a baking dish.

Bake in the preheated oven until no longer pink at the bone and the juices run clear, 45 to 50 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of a thigh, near the bone, should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).

video.description: You’ll love this simple, easy and delicious dish, especially for quick weeknight dinners and even impressing weekend guests! Combine 8 pieces cut from a whole chicken with onion wedges, lemon slices, garlic cloves and rosemary. Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and pepper and bake for under an hour until juicy on the inside and buttery golden on the outside. Serve with your favorite veg and potatoes, noodles or rice.
